title: The Air Merchant's Atonement
logline: A retired smuggler who once sold discounted life-support tanks to an asteroid mining crew discovers the cylinders were made with brittle valves and races to replace them before they fail.

roles.description: Former gray-market hauler who sold cheap oxygen tanks to miners; sick with dread after learning the entire factory lot is cracking.
Head of the asteroid drilling crew; suspicious, stubborn, refusing to halt mining shifts for unverified vendor warnings.
A hollowed-out asteroid quarry where sixty miners depend on a central oxygen manifold.
An industrial supply station carrying certified replacement brass regulator valves.

public_situation: An aging cargo hauler docks repeatedly at {role:mining_habitat}, offering free replacement life-support fittings to skeptical asteroid drillers.
private_truth: {role:penitent_smuggler} made his retirement fortune selling counterfeit military oxygen tanks that have begun suffering catastrophic metal fatigue.

beats.public_change: Notice boards at {role:foundry_depot} log an urgent private requisition for industrial brass pressure regulators.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to purchase certified regulator assemblies from the foundry and deliver them to the habitat airlock.
missions.private_fact: He learned three days ago that a hauler in a neighbouring system died when one of his old tanks ruptured without warning.

beats.public_change: Pressure gauges on the asteroid manifold begin fluctuating as drill shifts increase air consumption.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to scan the installed oxygen bank with an ultrasonic probe to determine which tanks are already developing micro-fractures.
missions.private_fact: He pocketed forty thousand credits on the original deal by buying condemned salvage cylinders from a scrap breaker.

beats.public_change: A hairline fracture vents freezing gas inside the habitat's central airlock, prompting the foreman to sound the evacuation bell.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver heavy silicate packing ballast to encase the failing manifold while the replacement valves are fitted under pressure.
missions.private_fact: He is prepared to spend his entire life savings paying the miners restitution if they let him replace the tanks before someone suffocates.

player_choice.prompt: The replacement valves are ready for installation, but the foreman demands to know who supplied the dangerous cylinders in the first place.

options.label: Confess the smuggler's past fraud and hand over his savings to pay miner damages
Fabricate a vendor recall notice to swap the valves quietly without admitting liability
Withdraw without finishing the work when the foreman threatens violent retribution

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the ballast, secures the manifold, and discloses the smuggler's culpability.
resolutions.summary: The tanks are replaced safely. {role:penitent_smuggler} surrenders his savings to {role:shaft_foreman} in restitution, ending his career broke but clear of blood.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped an old smuggler face angry miners to replace the defective air tanks he sold them years before.

resolutions.reached_by: The valves are fitted under a routine equipment recall pretext, concealing the smuggler's fraud.
resolutions.summary: The valves are replaced under a false recall notice. The miners breathe clean air, but {role:penitent_smuggler} lives in perpetual dread of exposure.

resolutions.reached_by: The replacement effort stalls or fails before the cracks can be secured.
resolutions.summary: The central manifold ruptures during shift pressurization. The habitat vents into space, forcing the evacuation of {role:mining_habitat} and ruining the mining season.

loose_threads.detail: The replacement valve crates bear secondary stencils matching an industrial liquidation sale held at an naval scrapper base.
High-pressure brass valves surged three hundred percent on local parts boards the day before the emergency recall began.

radio_hooks: Quarry operators report intermittent air pressure drops across deep mining shafts.
Industrial hardware outlets log run on high-pressure brass gas couplings.
Habitat health monitors remind crews to verify tank hydro-test dates.

voice_direction.penitent_smuggler: Desperate, apologetic, and cautious. Speaks in hushed, careful tones and constantly steers conversation away from where his cargo originated.
voice_direction.shaft_foreman: Suspicious, curt, and fatigued. Speaks in loud, blunt monosyllables and treats all outside cargo brokers as swindlers.

title: The Deep Aquifer Covenant
logline: An inter-system water treaty obligating a lush capital world to share ice reserves with parched mining settlements comes due during a drought, sparking an armed blockade.

roles.description: Envoys for drought-stricken outer mining outposts; gaunt, dignified, holding the original signed water treaty cylinder from forty years ago.
Ruler of the water-rich capital garden system; aristocratic, icy, determined to repudiate the water pact to preserve private planetary lakes.
A heavy private security frigate intercepting relief convoys along the inter-system jump corridor.
The coalition of arid outer asteroid colonies facing critical water rationing.
The elite landholding syndicate controlling the water-rich core planetary systems.
A dusty fuel station in the drought system where emergency cisterns stand empty.
A subterranean ice shelf on a frozen outer moon in an intermediate system where water reserves are held in escrow.
The floating orbital citadel in the capital system where treaty disputes are arbitrated.

public_situation: Outer asteroid belts face emergency water rationing while {role:capital_garden_trust} prepares to declare a historic water-sharing treaty void.
private_truth: {role:capital_archon} secretly ordered pumps at {role:aquifer_glacier} modified to siphon common treaty water into private capital cisterns.

beats.public_change: Notice boards at {role:border_depot} announce that life-support water rations have been cut by half across the asteroid belt.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to mine and deliver emergency water ice to replenish the station's failing condenser loops while treaty talks open.
missions.private_fact: His colonies only have twenty days of drinking water remaining before they are forced to abandon their mines.

beats.public_change: Capital security forces land at {role:aquifer_glacier}, posting notices that the escrow glacier is reserved exclusively for capital replenishment.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to retrieve the original brass covenant cylinder from the glacier archive vault before the archon's bailiffs seize the seals.
missions.private_fact: The covenant was signed forty years ago after outer asteroid miners saved the capital from an environmental crop collapse.

beats.public_change: Engineers discover that the glacier's automated pumping lines have been altered to bypass outer belt delivery locks.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to scan the subterranean pump manifold to record evidence that capital engineers diverted the shared treaty water.
missions.private_fact: The archon's family estates on the capital world use more water each week for decorative fountains than three mining settlements consume in a year.

beats.public_change: The pilot's vessel enters orbit above {role:capital_palace} where the archon's heavy flagship blocks the arbitral concourse.

missions.reason: The archon's frigate attempts to lock tractor beams on the pilot's ship to seize the covenant cylinder before it reaches the court.
missions.private_fact: The frigate captain hails offering ninety thousand credits and an estate on the garden world if the pilot destroys the cylinder.

missions.reason: Deliver the covenant cylinder and pump telemetry to the arbitral bench before the assembly votes to dissolve the treaty.
missions.private_fact: He fears that even if the treaty is enforced, the capital will seek revenge by raising freight tariffs on mining equipment.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the capital palace holding the forty-year-old water treaty cylinder and proof of the archon's secret diversions.

options.label: Table the covenant to force the capital to open water relief shipments to the miners
Sell the treaty cylinder to the archon in exchange for personal wealth and citizenship
Broker a revised agreement trading rare mining ores for guaranteed long-term water deliveries

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot tables the cylinder and proves the illegal diversion at the arbitral bench.
resolutions.summary: Faced with documented proof, {role:capital_archon} yields. Water pumps at {role:aquifer_glacier} are restored, and {role:mining_settlement_league} receives its rightful flow.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot carried an ancient brass treaty cylinder across three systems to make a proud capital honor its water pledge.

resolutions.reached_by: The covenant cylinder is suppressed or destroyed, or the pilot accepts the bribe.
resolutions.summary: The treaty is dissolved. {role:capital_garden_trust} keeps the water for its private gardens, forcing {role:mining_settlement_league} to evacuate outer outposts.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers an economic compromise exchanging mining ores for guaranteed water.
resolutions.summary: A revised compact trades outer asteroid ore quotas for guaranteed water shipments. {role:mining_settlement_league} survives, but at heavy industrial cost.

loose_threads.detail: A modified pump manifold on the glacier moon bears manufacturer serials linked to a private holding firm owned by the archon.
The covenant cylinder's seal was patched with modern synthetic wax matching customs stamps from the capital palace.
Inter-system water futures surged thirty percent on the capital exchange before the drought petition was officially filed.

radio_hooks: Mining settlements plead for emergency water shipments as local reservoirs run dry.
Capital assembly debates motion to declare historic frontier treaties obsolete.
Security fleets establish inter-system picket lines along glacier jump corridors.

voice_direction.border_commissioner: Gaunt, measured, and dignified. Speaks in solemn, unhurried cadences, treating treaty words like holy scripture.
voice_direction.capital_archon: Silky, dismissive, and patrician. Treats frontier miners as ungrateful dependents and insists resources belong to those who can afford them.
